articles.description: Buckeye Bridge and NFS Road 29 (Tiller Ranger District) will be closed Sept. 7–11 for road construction and bridge approach repairs. Please avoid the area and expect route changes during this five-day project. NFS Road 28 stays open, so South Umpqua Falls remains accessible.

articles.description: ODFW recommends avoiding softshell and bay clams from the Alsea Bay estuary near Waldport after very high saxitoxin levels were detected in nearby Eckman Lake. The recommendation is limited to Alsea Bay and is not a coastwide closure.
articles.title: ODFW Advises Against Harvesting Bay Clams in Alsea Bay
